interface.name: EmergencyStop
interface.description:
Emergency stop signal
FALSE: Emergency stop triggered
TRUE: No emergency stop triggered

scan_semantics: Inputs I[k] are sampled at invocation; outputs O[k] are observed after the call. Retained pre-state q[k] becomes q[k+1]. Each test resets the instance. A transition affects the same observed scan. dt_ms is elapsed time since the preceding invocation; the first invocation starts IEC timers at elapsed zero. CycleTime inputs, where supplied, are attributed to the current invocation rather than inferred from dt_ms.
safety_priority: Emergency stop overrides every mode and request.
Opposed directions and grip/release are mutually exclusive.
A reached position suppresses its own command immediately.
assumptions: EmergencyStop=FALSE cancels the sequence and outputs; recovery requires a fresh Start edge from a verified top-left pose.
A Start press is a rising edge. Start edges during an active action are ignored; edge history still updates.
No selected mode means all commands off and sequence reset. Changing mode also resets the sequence.
Opposing manual commands on an axis or grip pair are both inhibited. Independent non-opposing actions may run together.
Manual commands are combinational and stop on their matching limit/feedback. Contradictory limit switches are outside the caller contract.

Only one phase transition occurs per invocation. In cycle modes, completion feedback switches to the next command in that scan; an already-active next limit suppresses its command but is processed as completion on the next invocation.
Single-step completion switches all outputs off; the next action requires a fresh Start edge on a later scan.
Continuous completion of left movement wraps to down in the same scan. Single-cycle completion returns to idle.

At the start of a new automatic sequence (action 1, not every individual single step), UpLimitSwitch and LeftLimitSwitch must both be TRUE. Grip and release complete on the supplied feedback switches.

formal_properties.name: Safety
formal_properties.explanation: No command survives emergency stop or no mode.

formal_properties.name: Interlocks
formal_properties.explanation: Opposed actuators are never commanded together.

formal_properties.name: Manual down
formal_properties.explanation: Manual down requires the button and an unreached lower limit.

formal_properties.name: Reached limits
formal_properties.explanation: Every corresponding completion input suppresses its command.

formal_properties.name: Step wait
formal_properties.explanation: A completed single step waits for another press.

formal_properties.name: Automatic start
formal_properties.explanation: A permitted fresh start begins down.

formal_properties.name: Order
formal_properties.explanation: The eight preset actions retain their required order.

formal_properties.name: Conditional liveness
formal_properties.formula: (G(safe & SingleCycleMode) & G(busy -> F feedback)) -> G(started -> F idle)
formal_properties.explanation: With unchanged safe single-cycle mode and eventual matching feedback, every started sequence eventually returns idle.

atomic_propositions.no_mode: none of the four mode selectors TRUE
atomic_propositions.exclusive: NOT(MoveDown AND MoveUp) AND NOT(MoveLeft AND MoveRight) AND NOT(ActivateGrip AND ActivateRelease)
atomic_propositions.down_manual: ManualMode AND DownButton AND NOT UpButton AND NOT DownLimitSwitch
atomic_propositions.step_done: SingleStepMode AND pre-busy AND matching completion feedback
atomic_propositions.waiting: SingleStepMode AND NOT pre-busy AND NOT rising(Start)
atomic_propositions.cycle_done: SingleCycleMode AND pre-phase LEFT AND LeftLimitSwitch
atomic_propositions.continuous_done: ContinuousMode AND pre-phase LEFT AND LeftLimitSwitch
atomic_propositions.begin_next: post-phase DOWN with command gated by DownLimitSwitch
atomic_propositions.feedback: matching completion feedback for the pre-action is TRUE
atomic_propositions.start: fresh Start edge in idle with top-left pose and selected automatic mode
atomic_propositions.ordered: the next accepted automatic phase follows DOWN, GRIP, UP1, RIGHT, DOWN2, RELEASE, UP2, LEFT
